In this first episode of Motorfest Mastery, discover how to improve your Nitro management with @Sidwaj. 
Join us in the next episode to learn how to take turns effectively and upgrade your racing skills!

Check SidWaj channel right here: https://www.youtube.com/@SidWaj

About The Crew Motorfest:
Welcome to Motorfest! Discover the evergreen festival featuring the best experiences car culture has to offer. Complete your ultimate action driving bucket list through a series of tailor-made races, themed events, and other unique challenges. Explore the vibrant island of O’ahu in Hawaii alone or with your crew. Whatever the way you enjoy cars and driving, there is something in there for you!

author: Ubisoft
description:
The second part of a three-part trailer series for Anno 117: Pax Romana’s second DLC, The Hippodrome! Once you finish building Latium’s largest monument, you’ll have access to an exclusive new event: chariot races! Gather resources and host thrilling spectacles to satisfy your citizens’ hunger for entertainment. The racetrack is where legends are made and ordinary Specialists transform into unexpected heroes. Any Specialist can race, from a seasoned Roman veteran to the humble baker—who will you select to be your driver?

About Anno 117: Pax Romana:
In the latest instalment of the award-winning Anno strategy franchise, it’s your destiny to shape the Roman Empire in the year 117 AD. As governor, will you encourage economic growth or expand your rule through dominance? Lead with rebellion or unite a diverse culture? 
The cost of peace is yours to decide.
